craft.title: Craft & Process
craft.subtitle: Precision craftsmanship that elevates your packaging

hero.title: The Art of Precision, The Soul of Craftsmanship
hero.desc: LuxePack masters 8 core surface treatment processes — from silk-screen printing to laser engraving — every step is rigorously controlled to deliver a flawless brand expression.

intro.title: Our Core Processes
intro.subtitle: Complete surface treatment solutions for all beauty packaging categories

silkscreen.name: Silk-Screen Printing
silkscreen.desc: High-mesh silk screens precisely reproduce brand logos and artwork. Strong ink adhesion resists abrasion and solvents — ideal for flat and curved bottle surfaces.
silkscreen.specs: Precision ±0.1mm · Up to 8-color registration · Glass / Plastic / Metal

hotStamping.name: Hot Stamping / Silver Stamping
hotStamping.desc: Thermal transfer foil technology perfectly transfers gold, silver, or holographic metallic finishes in a single step. Long-lasting color with an unmistakably premium feel.
hotStamping.specs: Gold / Silver / Holographic foil · Heat resistance 80°C · Flat & curved surfaces

electroplating.name: Electroplating (Vacuum Metallizing)
electroplating.desc: Vacuum deposition creates a uniform metallic film on the bottle surface — mirror or matte finish, zero heavy metals, fully compliant with EU environmental standards.
electroplating.specs: Mirror / Matte / Brushed · 0.1–0.3μm thickness · RoHS certified

uvTransfer.name: UV Transfer Printing
uvTransfer.desc: UV-cured technology transfers special texture patterns onto bottle surfaces, achieving leather grain, carbon fiber, marble, and more to enhance product identity.
uvTransfer.specs: 50+ texture types · Adjustable gloss · Compatible with multiple substrates

spraying.name: Spraying
spraying.desc: Rubber-touch, gloss, and matte lacquer options with Pantone-accurate color matching — access 5,000+ color solutions. The go-to process for brand color customization.
spraying.specs: Pantone accurate · Matte / Gloss / Rubber texture · Eco water-based lacquer

laser.name: Laser Engraving
laser.desc: High-precision laser etches patterns and text permanently into the bottle surface — no fade, no peel, 0.01mm precision. Ideal for premium limited-edition packaging.
laser.specs: 0.01mm precision · No consumables · Glass / Metal / Acrylic

padPrinting.name: Pad Printing
padPrinting.desc: Silicone pad transfers flat artwork onto any curved surface — the best solution for irregular bottle shapes, offering rich color layers and fine detail.
padPrinting.specs: Complex curved surfaces · Up to 6 colors · Precision ±0.2mm

shrinkSleeve.name: Shrink Sleeve Label
shrinkSleeve.desc: 360° full-body graphic coverage that conforms perfectly to the bottle after heat shrinking. Ideal for complex gradients and large-area artwork — a favorite for makeup and fragrance.
shrinkSleeve.specs: 360° full coverage · 50–70% shrink ratio · Matte / Gloss film

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: 15 years of beauty packaging expertise, growing with 200+ global brands

story.title: Crafted with Purpose, Since 2010
story.p1: LuxePack was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Guangzhou. We are a comprehensive enterprise focused on the R&D, design, and manufacturing of premium beauty packaging. Our founding team has over 15 years of deep industry experience and understands both the quality and design innovation demands of global beauty brands.
story.p2: With three major production and service centers in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hangzhou, we have built a proprietary surface treatment laboratory, a 3D digital design team, and a fully integrated supply chain — delivering end-to-end solutions from concept design to mass production.
story.p3: To date, LuxePack has served over 200 beauty brands across 50+ countries and regions. Our products span skincare, makeup, fragrance, and home care — trusted by international buyers worldwide.
